title: Use Hospital HMI "Remove Tote" screen to remove a tote from the system
summary: On the Hospital HMI, scan the tote barcode to populate Tote ID/Barcode fields, verify extract-side position information from WCS (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status), ensure the tote is positioned properly on the extract side, then press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to remove the tote from the system.
when_to_use: Use when a tote is at the Hospital Station extract side and the station operator needs to remove that tote from the system so the required task can be performed.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the Hospital HMI Remove Tote workflow (scan tote barcode, verify extract-side WCS position information, ensure tote is positioned properly on the extract side, then press CONFIRM & EXECUTE).
safety_notes: Do not press CONFIRM & EXECUTE until the tote is positioned properly on the extract side.
access_or_tools_needed: Hospital HMI access to the "Remove Tote" screen

access_required: Hospital HMI / lane UI access to the "Remove Tote" screen
system_preconditions: The tote to be removed is positioned on the Hospital Station extract side.

visual_references.description: Hospital HMI Remove Tote screen (Figure 4-32) showing Tote ID and Barcode scan controls, CONFIRM & EXECUTE button, and Extract Position Information panel (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status), plus Add Tote shortcut.

steps.title: Open the Hospital HMI "Remove Tote" screen
steps.purpose: Access the workflow controls used to remove a tote from the system.
steps.instruction: Open the Hospital HMI screen labeled "Remove Tote".
steps.expected_result: The Hospital HMI "Remove Tote" screen is displayed with fields/controls for Tote ID, Barcode, CONFIRM & EXECUTE, and the Extract Position Information panel.
steps.healthy_condition: The screen shows the Remove Tote workflow elements (Tote ID scan, Barcode scan, CONFIRM & EXECUTE, and Extract Position Information from WCS).
steps.failure_condition: The "Remove Tote" screen is not available or the expected fields/panel are not visible.

actions.label: Open Remove Tote screen
actions.exact_action: Open the Hospital HMI "Remove Tote" screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 4.1.3.2.3: 1.2 REMOVE TOTE describes the "Remove Tote" screen used to remove a tote from the system (Figure 4-32).

steps.title: Scan tote barcode to populate the Tote ID field
steps.purpose: Populate the Tote ID field using the green scanner so the correct tote is targeted for removal.
steps.instruction: In the Tote ID area, use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate the Tote ID field.
steps.expected_result: The Tote ID field is populated after scanning the tote bar code.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote ID field updates from the scanned tote bar code.
steps.failure_condition: Tote ID field does not populate (or populates with an unexpected value).

actions.label: Scan Tote ID
actions.exact_action: Use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate with the tote ID.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-32 / Table 4-17: Tote ID — "Use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate with the tote ID."

steps.title: Scan tote barcode to populate the Barcode field
steps.purpose: Populate the Barcode field using the green scanner as required by the Remove Tote workflow.
steps.instruction: In the Barcode area, press the Barcode scan control and then use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate the Barcode field.
steps.expected_result: The Barcode field is populated after scanning the tote bar code.
steps.healthy_condition: Barcode field updates from the scanned tote bar code.
steps.failure_condition: Barcode field does not populate or shows information that does not correspond to the tote you intend to remove.

actions.label: Scan Barcode
actions.exact_action: Press and then use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-32 / Table 4-17: Barcode — "Press and then use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code."

steps.title: Verify Extract Position Information for the extract side (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status)
steps.purpose: Confirm the WCS-provided extract-side details match the tote you intend to remove before executing removal.
steps.instruction: Verify the "Extract Position Information" panel shows WCS data for the extract side, including AGV# (ID of the AGV at the extract side), Tote ID (ID of the tote at the extract side), Bar Code (scanned information), and Status (status messages received from the WCS about the tote).
steps.expected_result: Extract Position Information panel displays AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status values for the extract side.
steps.healthy_condition: The Extract Position Information values correspond to the tote you intend to remove (and the Status messages are consistent with the tote at the extract side).
steps.failure_condition: Extract Position Information does not match the tote you intend to remove (e.g., AGV#, Tote ID, or Bar Code mismatch).

actions.label: Check Extract Position Information
actions.exact_action: Verify the "Extract Position Information" panel shows WCS data for the extract side, including AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Extract Position Information (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status) does not match the tote you intend to remove, re-scan using the green scanner controls before executing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-32 / Table 4-17: Extract Position Information — "This is information received from the WCS" and lists AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status.

steps.title: Ensure the tote is positioned properly on the extract side
steps.purpose: Prevent incorrect removal by confirming the physical tote location matches the extract-side WCS information.
steps.instruction: Ensure the tote is positioned properly on the extract side of the Hospital Station.
steps.expected_result: The tote is physically located on the extract side, ready for removal.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote is correctly placed on the extract side (consistent with the Extract Position Information panel).
steps.failure_condition: Tote is not positioned properly on the extract side.

actions.label: Confirm tote placement
actions.exact_action: Ensure the tote is positioned properly on the extract side.

stop_or_escalate_if: Do not press CONFIRM & EXECUTE until the tote is positioned properly on the extract side.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Table 4-17: Confirm & Execute — "After the tote is positioned properly on the extract side, press CONFIRM & EXECUTE..."

Hospital Station Operation describes that an AGV brings a tote to the right side of the hospital station for extraction and that the induct side is the left side; it also references using the green scanner and ensuring the tote is flush against end stops when re-entering.

steps.title: Press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to remove the tote from the system
steps.purpose: Trigger the system-side removal of the tote once the tote is correctly positioned and WCS extract-side information is verified.
steps.instruction: Press the CONFIRM & EXECUTE button to remove the tote from the system.
steps.expected_result: The tote is removed from the system using the Remove Tote screen workflow; the screen reflects the removal action and the Extract Position Information panel reflects the WCS-provided extract-side details.
steps.healthy_condition: Removal is executed after the tote is positioned properly on the extract side (per the workflow), and the Extract Position Information panel continues to show WCS-provided extract-side details.
steps.failure_condition: CONFIRM & EXECUTE is pressed before the tote is positioned properly on the extract side, or the Extract Position Information does not match the tote intended for removal.

actions.label: Confirm & Execute removal
actions.exact_action: After the tote is positioned properly on the extract side, press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to remove the tote from the system so the station operator can perform the required task.

stop_or_escalate_if: Do not press CONFIRM & EXECUTE until the tote is positioned properly on the extract side.
If the Extract Position Information (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status) does not match the tote you intend to remove, re-scan using the green scanner controls before executing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Table 4-17: Confirm & Execute Button — "After the tote is positioned properly on the extract side, press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to remove the tote from the system..."

steps.title: Use Add Tote shortcut if needed
steps.purpose: Navigate to the Add Tote screen when a different tote needs to be added to the system for the AGV at the Hospital Station.
steps.instruction: If needed, use the "Add Tote" shortcut button to navigate to the "Add Tote" screen.
steps.expected_result: The Hospital HMI navigates to the "Add Tote" screen.
steps.healthy_condition: Add Tote shortcut is available on the Remove Tote screen and navigation succeeds.
steps.failure_condition: Shortcut does not navigate to the Add Tote screen.

actions.label: Navigate to Add Tote
actions.exact_action: Use the "Add Tote" shortcut button to navigate to the "Add Tote" screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Table 4-17: "Add Tote" button — "A shortcut button to the \"Add Tote\" screen."

success_criteria: Tote removal is executed via the Hospital HMI Remove Tote screen workflow (CONFIRM & EXECUTE pressed after tote is positioned properly on the extract side).
Extract Position Information panel shows WCS-provided extract-side details including AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status.
healthy_conditions: Tote ID and Barcode fields populate after scanning with the green scanner.
Extract Position Information panel shows AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status values consistent with the tote intended for removal.
CONFIRM & EXECUTE is pressed only after the tote is positioned properly on the extract side.
failure_conditions: Extract Position Information (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status) does not match the tote intended for removal.
Tote is not positioned properly on the extract side when attempting removal.
escalation_guidance: If Extract Position Information does not match the tote you intend to remove, re-scan using the green scanner controls before executing. If mismatch persists after re-scanning, stop and escalate to appropriate support per site process (no additional escalation path is specified in the provided source section).
